name: Data Converter
description: Convert anything in one DBX workbench panel: 13 formats (JSON / YAML / XML / Properties / TOML / INI / .env / CSV / TSV / Query / Headers / Cookie / HTML) in any combination, JSONPath / jq queries with JSON Schema validation, eight escape tools (URL / Base64 / HTML / JSON / Unicode / Hex / SQL / Regex), batch text to SQL (IN / NOT IN / INSERT), .xlsx / .csv / .tsv to JSON, Image ⇄ Base64, and a Byte Converter (B/KB/MB/GB/TB/PB on both the 1000 and 1024 scales, exact ⇄ human readable, batch totals, plus hex dump / byte array / binary string). A Code Gen page turns a JSON sample or a CREATE TABLE into TypeScript / Go / Java / Python models. Pure frontend, no backend, works offline.

versions.releaseNotes: Initial release with multi-format conversion, mock data generation, and i18n support.

0.1.5 (update): a new Byte Converter page converts B / KB / MB / GB / TB / PB on the 1000 and 1024 scales side by side (1234567890 → 1.23 GB and 1.15 GiB), goes back from a human-readable value to an exact byte count, handles batches of sizes with a running total, and turns byte sequences (1f 8b 08, [0x1f, 0x8b], binary, xxd dumps) into hex dump / byte array / binary string. The Convert page now handles 13 formats in any source/target combination — TOML, INI, .env, CSV, TSV, query strings, HTTP headers, cookie strings and HTML tables join JSON / YAML / XML / Properties. A Query page runs JSONPath and jq-style expressions and validates against a JSON Schema draft-07 subset, an Escaping page converts both ways between URL / Base64 / HTML / JSON string / \uXXXX / hex / SQL / regex, and Code Gen turns JSON or CREATE TABLE into TypeScript / Go / Java / Python models. All nine pages are translated into 14 languages, and everything runs locally: no network, no eval, with hard limits on size, rows and columns.
